$comment: Phase-0 ingest scope for Missouri: the clauses the game actually cites. scripts/harvest-mo.mjs fetches these from the official Revisor site on a GitHub Actions runner (sandbox egress is blocked); the adapter then extracts from the committed raw pages. Expand this list to widen the corpus — everything downstream is driven by it. Section URLs use the Revisor's lenient form (?constit=y&section=<ROMAN>++<label>); the opaque bid parameter is deliberately not used because it is version-scoped and cannot be derived.
